# Bishnu Bhaban

> Bishnu Bhaban is a budget hotel at the West Gate of the Shri Jagannath Temple, Grand Road, Puri, Odisha 752001, India. It is roughly 50 to 280 metres from the temple complex on foot, and is primarily used for statue/pilgrimage darshan stays, family visits and group bookings. Rooms are air-conditioned and non-AC, with attached western bathrooms, 24-hour hot water, free WiFi, daily housekeeping, CCTV security and a front desk open 24 hours.

[Bishnu Bhaban Home](https://bishnubhaban.com/)

For up-to-date room inventory, prices and availability, this site publishes data fetched at build time from thehotelmate (property 3637 for Bishnu Bhaban, property 3638 for Jamindar Nest). Live booking runs on bookone.io.

## Practical notes

- The property is for a pilgrimage stay: clean, simple rooms, strong location, honest budget pricing, no on-site restaurant (vegetarian restaurants and Grand Road sweet shops are a short walk away).
- Front desk is open 24 hours; check-in from 2:00 PM, check-out by 11:00 AM.
- Luggage storage is available after checkout.
- Swimming at Puri Beach is discouraged due to strong currents; the beach is a roughly 1.5 km walk or short auto ride.
